whole_evidence.text: --- record_id: mytheme-neumann-images title: Neumann images and plate relations aliases: - Neumann images and plate relations record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Argued from source_ids: - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 --- # Neumann images and plate relations ## #0 The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them can stand apart and call them parents. In Neumann's creation sequence, heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together. Its apparently enclosed outline carries the life that will differentiate it: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The first pressure in the image is therefore genesis: how a world and a centre within that world become distinct through a relation neither creates alone. This whole carries **shared archetypal structuration**: genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. It is the archetypal ground through which geographically situated tellings and temporal developments become comparable. Geography gives each telling its people, language and historical home; temporality gives its transformations their order and duration. Those registers remain distinct from the common structure disclosed here. The universal field belongs to the essay's native QL account; Neumann supplies a developed psychological morphology through which that field receives an imaginal and bodily refraction. His sequence is neither the derivation of QL nor a geographical address for the universal. [Neumann's source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the telling: the uroboros, Great Mother, separation of the World Parents, birth of the hero, slaying of mother and father, liberation of the captive and treasure, then the Osiris transformation. His book presents these as stages in the development of consciousness. The source's stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return. ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round. ## #2 Separation of the World Parents opens the interval in which a world can appear. Heaven is distinguishable from earth; light can enter the space between them. An undifferentiated enclosure becomes an articulated field with directions and contrasts. The ego emerges within this opening as a position able to discriminate. What appears outside it becomes nameable because the act of differentiation has also given the observer a place. The transmitted creation scene at the encounter's p.105 lead requires its own sequence. The primordial person recognises itself, then divides into the paired figure of man and woman previously held as if in an embrace. Self-recognition precedes sexual separation in this telling. The androgyne therefore performs a relational office: the two who become partners arise through differentiation of a prior togetherness. The image places sex and gender within a genesis of relation; its use here depends upon preserving the before, the embrace, the division and the changed relation afterward. The independent primary passage and its exact translation remain a source debt. Neumann's psychological reading stresses the achievement of ego identity and the discriminating consciousness that says I am I. Taylor's response separates that achievement from the more primordial self-recognition expressed in the native relation. Prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession of an identity; the finite experiencer and its inner instrument are determinations within the field of appearing. This authored distinction **returns-to** [the tattvic differential field](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), and **qualifies** [the bounded subject-position](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [the inner instrument](../../../episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation. It cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears. **Human-amplified: yes** for this explicit correction in Taylor's encounter; the psychological and Śaiva source offices retain their own evidence requirements. Light brings more than a collection of visible objects. In the leads at pp.106–109, an oriented world appears: above and below, before and behind, inside and outside, I and you, sacred and profane, good and evil. Boundaries make a precinct, a possession, a law and an order of action possible. Some of those institutional consequences are Taylor's authored extension of the encounter, not a verified universal history derived from Neumann. Their formal pressure is exact: a measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it. [Māyā as operative measure](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **qualifies** this refraction. Differentiation is productive; its danger begins when the selected measure conceals its dependence upon a wider field. The image cannot be held to a fixed light/good and dark/bad dictionary. Light names disclosure from one position; what that position leaves unlit belongs to the same field. Father and mother, active and receptive, inner and outer likewise change office with the direction of the relation. Taylor's local p.108 appointment of night at #0, day at #5 and four directions at #1–#4 gives this encounter a 4+2 articulation: the spatially specified field is held through implicate conditions of appearance and return. **Human-amplified: yes** for that local appointment. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable. The twins give this danger two faces within one genesis. Taylor's [core theorem account, IV](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the named Ohrmazd/Ahriman appointment: the broken halves of a prior `0` become enemies when their division is made to deny their belonging. [Q27's energetics and Neumann return](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** the same operation at the good/evil twins. Their opposition has real force; what changes is how the relation between them is held. Through `/`, their different valences still have one ground. When the stroke becomes addition between isolated signs, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, the meeting cancels them. When it becomes subtraction, `(-1)-(+1)=-2` or `(+1)-(-1)=+2`, one side takes the span as its own. The other is then encountered only as what must disappear for the governing side to be whole. The return has to preserve the two who can recognise their shared genesis. Blending them would destroy the difference through which recognition occurs; victory understood as abolishing the other's ground would perpetuate the divorce. The prior `0` returns as their condition, rather than as the null result of their collision. The narrative pressure is therefore the same one that will meet the hero: what kind of separation permits a life in relation, and what kind makes continued separation its war? This authored image **returns-to** [A13's two logics](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) through the changed operator, and **returns-to** [A18's complete field](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) without substituting two gods for its eight determinations. **Human-amplified: yes** for this existing Taylor operation, now made explicit in its assigned whole. Ohrmazd and Ahriman retain the naming supplied by the core; no independent Zurvanite telling, chronology, ritual or account of an historical orthodoxy has been recovered here. The core's fall-administering-itself judgment is its mythemic interpretation. Historical attribution remains a separate source task. Neumann's comparative morphology supplies the shared separation field; it is not being cited as the source of Taylor's notation or as verification of this named religious history. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. Its weakness and dependence do not disappear because it can name itself; the power of discrimination exposes them differently. The separation cannot simply be reversed without surrendering the differentiated life it enabled. This is why the story must pass through the hero. Something has to bear the cost of leaving while finding a relation to what has been left. ## #3 The hero is born within the world opened by the separation. Neumann's sequence then carries two emancipations: the slaying of the mother, followed by the slaying of the father. The maternal struggle addresses the engulfing origin from which the hero must become distinct. The paternal struggle addresses the authority that can arrest that emergence in an inherited order. If the telling stopped after escape from the mother, the father's law could simply inherit the power of enclosure. Keeping both struggles in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, rather than to the replacement of one captor by another. The violence belongs to the mythic and psychological telling. Its operation is differentiation from an overwhelming archetypal claim. Neumann's historically gendered morphology remains visible as his account. The page's relational reading follows the changing offices in the drama, including the earlier androgyne and the later possibility of partnership. Removing those changes would turn a developing relation into a static classification of persons. The next movement is the captive, the treasure and liberation. In the book's order this precedes the Osiris transformation. The achieved power to separate is now tested by what it releases and what becomes available through release. A captive liberated into another form of possession would leave the deeper problem intact. That last sentence states the essay's authored pressure upon the image: heroic efficacy has to be judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters. It does not invent a missing passage in Neumann's account. The Osiris division then carries the book's culminating transformation office. Death and transformation prevent the developmental movement from closing as the hero's permanent occupancy of a victorious identity. The canonical source navigation warrants this office and sequence; it does not yet warrant a detailed retelling of every Osiris episode. Detailed Osiris episodes require separately recovered primary tellings and comparative passages. Here the consequential change is that an ego strong enough to emerge must also become capable of transformation beyond its established form. Centroversion gathers the movement. The formation of a whole personality requires traffic between the centre and the powers from which it differentiated. Both engulfment and sovereign isolation obstruct that traffic. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. This source-specific psychological account **returns-to** [individuation and recognition](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). [Jung's *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychic distinction between ego and encompassing Self; it supplies no authorship of the notation `X/x` and no retrospective proof of Taylor's derivation. Taylor's encounter leaves the hero/spiritual-avatar distinction as a live question. The heroic sacred marriage and uroboric reabsorption cannot be merged simply because both images contain union. One follows differentiation and can sustain relationship; the other can abolish the separate position through which relationship is lived. Whether a particular avatar drama carries a different office requires its own whole telling. **Human-amplified: no** for closing that unresolved identification. The story recovered here has earned a return through differentiated participation; it has not earned permission to treat all transformations as the same event. ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter. The paper scene carries the more intimate pressure of Taylor's p.17 [authorial encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/NOTES.md), which **sources** the connection between uroboric incest and erasure. In the encountered image, desire turns toward being dissolved and absorbed into the round. Taylor reads the `1` slipping back into `0`, then makes that movement performable on the page. The first mark, its acknowledged ground and the slash have all become a written figure. Erasing that figure releases its claim to stand as the ground it has named. The page can receive another inscription; the capacity to distinguish remains live. This changes what dissolution can accomplish. Uroboric reabsorption can surrender the differentiated position altogether; the enacted erasure can instead leave a reader able to begin again with knowledge of the inscription's dependence. The sacred marriage retains another office: differentiated partners sustain a generative relation rather than disappearing into undifferentiated containment. The p.17 encounter connects the incest motif to *hieros gamos* while questioning the priority assigned to hero and spiritual avatar. That question remains open. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's incest–self-relation–erasure amplification; **human-amplified: no** for settling the hero/avatar hierarchy. The copied Neumann passage remains uncollated, and this native use does not turn it into a quotation-ready source claim. The next page lead gives the renewed act a moving image: the self-rolling wheel. Taylor's p.18 encounter places En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel, then follows its rolling as a continuing self-composition about the unobjectified opening. The formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding and weaving of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once and left inert. The paper's capacity for another inscription and the wheel's continuing composition meet at this renewal. Each achieved figure belongs to the field through which another figure can appear. The wheel thus **returns-to** [the uroboros's interposition](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition): a locally completed round can retain the passage through which it was made and return with a difference. The opening remains constitutive without becoming another patch of surface. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's self-composition and Text/Texture appointment. En-Soph's historical terminology, Neumann's exact p.18 wording and the encounter's proposed Whitehead comparison retain their independent source standing. Neither perpetual mechanical motion nor a topology theorem is established by a self-rolling image. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source. ## #5→0 The separation returns as a question of love or war. Taylor's p.121 encounter makes knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim that its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of a shared genesis. Even denial takes place through the field it denies. This is a formal and mythemic assertion about relation. Separation made the world and the responsive centre possible. Its return has to preserve that achievement. The exact difference **returns-to** [the two logics of two](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). Polar distinction is necessary. Its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation: `(-1)+(+1)=0` cancels the signed terms, while `(-1)-(+1)=-2` and the inverse subtraction `(+1)-(-1)=+2` carry the two appropriative orientations. The native relation `(0/1)/(1/0)` retains the directions together without converting QL's slash into ordinary division by zero. Taylor's guilt reading locates the loss in a determination disowning its `/0`; the relation itself has not been annihilated. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cut/bond and love/war reading in the protected encounter. The claim survives with productive difference and the right of actual others to answer on their own terms. The differentiated world now sees its own means of seeing. This whole **returns-to** [contextual transparency](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **figures** [diaphaneity](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): light, boundary and orientation become available together with the source relations and exclusions that made them effective. [Gebser's source house](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **compares** a distinct account of consciousness structures and integral transparency. Its contextual return can illuminate this passage without equating its structures one for one with Neumann's stadial sequence. **Human-amplified: no** for such a blanket stage identity. The shared field retains both accounts in their distinct temporal and epistemic offices. The centre's power to discriminate **returns-to** [local arbitration](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), **qualifies** [the complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md), and **extends** the question into [image, valuation and possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). An image helps organise action; possession begins when that organisation claims the authority of its own source. The Great Mother as engulfing power, the father's arresting law and the victorious hero are different possible occupants of that office. None is condemned simply for giving a world its form. [Arbitration, hybris, regard and anamnesis](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the return of judgement: the determining centre must recognise the conditions of its measure and allow encounter to alter it. [The living symbol and idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) and [the archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **qualify** the source/image distinction. The image remains alive while the relation can change its meaning; its power of disclosure is lost when its present interpretation is made final. The liberated relation **returns-to** [trust, faith and the formal limit](../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [self and other without possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). Shared origin neither eliminates risk nor gives one participant ownership of another. Trust has force because the response cannot be manufactured in advance; recognition includes the possibility that an actual other changes the terms of the encounter. The captive and the heroic union carry this pressure as images. They do not prove the historical or ethical claims of every story to which those names have been applied. For [mind as worldhood](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), to which this whole **returns-to**, the developing centre and its world form together through discrimination, valuation, inherited relation and response. The shared archetypal field supplies more than a sequence of private mental contents. It is a condition of intelligible individuation. The technical extension asks how an agent's context, memory, tools and collective relations can make that formation inspectable; artificial phenomenality and the encounter's question of a reversed individual-to-collective developmental route remain **Open**. **Human-amplified: no** for an achieved technical mechanism or a phenomenality conclusion. The structural claim is retained at full strength without inventing its implementation. This same distinction **returns-to** [idealism and order of dependence](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The primordial relation is ontologically and epistemically consequential in the essay; it is not the chronological manufacture of the world by a private ego. The centre cannot make the conditions of appearing into its possession. Its return therefore **returns-to** [compassion as loving sensitivity to origins](../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): what has become this person or this act includes nourishment, deprivation, dependence, separation and labour. Knowing those origins becomes compassion through the orientation that refuses to consume the being it understands. Responsibility remains; a more adequate field becomes available in which to exercise it. [Taylor's Draft 3 source house](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **extends** that return through the offered work and the reader's office of remembrance. Finally, this whole **qualifies** [the first advent of zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) and **returns-to** [the advent of integral zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md). The round and the paper scene do not establish the history of mathematical zero. They let the exact sign re-enter a living symbolic relation after its mathematical office has been earned. The return preserves that office. As the transformed centre retains its differentiation, the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign. What comes back is the capacity to begin with the source relation visible in the determination: a mark made, a world opened, a separation borne, an image released to be answered. The source standing remains precise. Neumann is citation-ready, with selected external passages still unpromoted; the page leads belong to the consulted 2014 Princeton Classics encounter, whose pagination has not been collated against the 1954 English edition. No copied Neumann or transmitted Upaniṣadic sentence is presented here as quotation-ready. Jung's *Aion* has no selected excerpts ready in its current house; Gebser retains locator debts. Taylor's native material is internally sourced, and the protected encounter distinguishes authorial reading from its initial scaffold. **Human-amplified: no** for the scaffold's unratified one-to-one Taoist, gender or stadial equivalences. These provenance limits **qualify** historical attribution and quotation; they leave the declared **Argued** mythemic operations and native formal derivation in their proper force.

A view flips; context then holds views together without claiming one final reading.
Here/there and changing play culminate in checkmate and another game.
Knowability of the unknown and unknowability of the known return as Known/Knower.
Knowing one and becoming no-one enact recognition.
Zero, One and All remain in one relational utterance.
Field/way, sealed/opening, wind and bird return Real as re-All.
Near/far, old/new and many/few change the seeking relation.
Humanised spirituality refuses institutions that devour the human.
Waking confronts tiredness and bullshit in the poem’s own voice.
Law, window, wind and pigeonhole test freedom’s relation to form.
Borders, defence and pretence disclose the cost of guarded identity.
P0: two roads of two; cancellation and 2+4 remain distinct.
P1: binary limitation returns to shared root and power.
P2: language fixes and frays; life releases its achieved form.
P3: one-and-done is answered by the retained relation of two Ones.
P4: the underlying One question exposes framing, cloud and humility with precision.
P5: God is context rather than an argumentative object.
Plain horror and love/fear retain the poem’s affective force.
Scratching is the itch: desire, capture, child/sin, healing and brothers remain in sequence.
Beyond consequence is not inconsequential: journey becomes residential.
The notion born of difference extends the companion consequence poem.
Infinite multiplied by infinitesimal returns to one sentence and sameness/difference.
Feeling is undergoing: sea, winds, captain’s boots, Venus/Sophia/Martian figures retain local poetic offices.
Surface/layers, shoe/sole and unreturn preserve the Blake-facing poetic turn.
Finite mind confronts source, law or archetypal totality; the divine-mind reading has its own register.
Disowned internal difference resists the ego’s completed self-model.
Another centre shares a world while exceeding one psyche’s production of it.
Denied uncertainty is projected into an externalised negative pole.

whole_evidence.text: ## #3 **Interposition** gives the complete creature its winding. The mouth, head, tail, body, inner and outer surfaces, and retained opening now belong to one articulated movement. Taylor’s `4+2` appointment keeps four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates in play. In the final quilt’s image, the axis and the hole are gathered at `#0`, while `#5` is the whole enfolding the differentiated winding. The fourfold can turn and return because its implicate conditions remain operative. The [matheme of torus, covering and winding](../../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) **grounds** the exact topological neighbour: $$ T^2=\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2, \qquad \chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0, \qquad \pi_1(T^2)\cong\mathbb{Z} imes\mathbb{Z}. $$ Its square has four sides before gluing, two generating edge classes, one vertex and one face after gluing. The matheme’s four-sides/two-generators correspondence and the quilt’s four-field-lines/axis-and-hole appointment have different counted objects. Their relation must remain readable across the change of register. In particular, a drawing’s central aperture is not a third generating loop or an extra surface cell. Let a path on the torus be `γ(t)=[2t,−t]`, for `0≤t≤1`. It returns to its starting address, while the lift beginning at `(0,0)` ends at `(2,−1)`. The creature’s homecoming now has an exact neighbouring operation: local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation. The integer pair records the winding class; the lifted path carries more of the traversal than its endpoint alone. The mythemic comparison preserves this retained difference. [A17](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **grounds** the return with retained displacement, and [C52](../../../episteme/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the distinct quotient, covering and reframing operations. The infinite plane cover is not the separate two-sheeted torus-to-Klein construction. **Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening in the authorial appointment. Māyā is the measure-field wound around it.** Śakti’s winding makes the formal patterns through which manifestation reflects toward prakāśa in vimarśa. Pattern, measure and contraction give a determinate world its real capacities. The opening never becomes one more bounded patch among them. Śakti’s joy in Māyā belongs to this generative movement: articulation is a power of manifestation, and the particular body is its positive achievement. [A09](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [C14](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) and [C15](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **ground** the distinction between originating condition, operative measure and bounded knower. The trick succeeds when the formed pattern makes its dependence unavailable to its own account. It can then portray its measure as self-grounding. Filling the hole in the familiar toroidal image would change the form whose wholeness was to be perfected. The same demand, lived psychically, makes coherence depend on excluding whatever could alter the achieved identity. [A16](../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the field of possible differentiation, while [C64](../../../episteme/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **extends** the need to transform a containing account while retaining the local truths it had made incompatible. The [complete eight determinations](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) remain active through this image. The parent `/ = −/−` opens into `0/1`; appearance questions and asserts as `?/!`; hunger and issue articulate `−/+`; recurrent capacity becomes legible through the particular as `X/x`; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed; `∞/dx` holds the definite passage against its inexhaustible horizon; `1/0` returns the formed relation toward its source. These are the whole field’s eight turns, with six interior determinations bracketed by parent and return. They are not eight chronological phases assigned to a snake. [A18](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their sequence and inversions: Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing remain crossed by Essence, Constitution and Text–Texture. Both orientations carry the complete relation. Name and Power remain together, so that an achieved Image also carries the Work, expenditure and transformation of its coming to be.

whole_evidence.text: The twins give this danger two faces within one genesis. Taylor's [core theorem account, IV](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the named Ohrmazd/Ahriman appointment: the broken halves of a prior `0` become enemies when their division is made to deny their belonging. [Q27's energetics and Neumann return](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** the same operation at the good/evil twins. Their opposition has real force; what changes is how the relation between them is held. Through `/`, their different valences still have one ground. When the stroke becomes addition between isolated signs, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, the meeting cancels them. When it becomes subtraction, `(-1)-(+1)=-2` or `(+1)-(-1)=+2`, one side takes the span as its own. The other is then encountered only as what must disappear for the governing side to be whole. The return has to preserve the two who can recognise their shared genesis. Blending them would destroy the difference through which recognition occurs; victory understood as abolishing the other's ground would perpetuate the divorce. The prior `0` returns as their condition, rather than as the null result of their collision. The narrative pressure is therefore the same one that will meet the hero: what kind of separation permits a life in relation, and what kind makes continued separation its war? This authored image **returns-to** [A13's two logics](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) through the changed operator, and **returns-to** [A18's complete field](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) without substituting two gods for its eight determinations. **Human-amplified: yes** for this existing Taylor operation, now made explicit in its assigned whole. Ohrmazd and Ahriman retain the naming supplied by the core; no independent Zurvanite telling, chronology, ritual or account of an historical orthodoxy has been recovered here. The core's fall-administering-itself judgment is its mythemic interpretation. Historical attribution remains a separate source task. Neumann's comparative morphology supplies the shared separation field; it is not being cited as the source of Taylor's notation or as verification of this named religious history. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. Its weakness and dependence do not disappear because it can name itself; the power of discrimination exposes them differently. The separation cannot simply be reversed without surrendering the differentiated life it enabled. This is why the story must pass through the hero. Something has to bear the cost of leaving while finding a relation to what has been left.

whole_evidence.text: The reserve also enters Taylor's [Q27 energetics](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), which **sources** the earthlight and tokamak pair. In that authored comparison, earthlight carries unconfined discharge: what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive. Tokamak confinement carries a different relation to energetic power: the field holds charged plasma so that its activity can continue within an arranged containment. Release and holding therefore do different work. An opening is not simply a leak to be sealed, and containment need not be the devouring closure that prevents return. The quilt places the latent dot at the reserve beneath extension, the `−` under the manifest `+`. That reserve lets the pair deepen the creature's metabolic fork. A formed field which denies its conditions cannot account for their return; a field which holds activity through an answerable arrangement can sustain a further passage. The distinction concerns what the containing form permits and acknowledges. It does not make every discharge liberating or every confinement healthy. The uroboros's return has to retain both the source it cannot fill and the differentiated field through which power acts. [ITER's canonical source house](../../../episteme/sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q001) **sources** the bounded technical instance: a doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma and magnetic confinement. It does not establish all field-line geometry or a universal preference for toroidal confinement. The earthlight remains the quilt's named image of unconfined discharge and the excluded ground's return; no particular observation, location, plasma mechanism or causal explanation of an earthlight event is verified here. Libido, prāṇa, Śakti, spanda and technical energy retain their distinct registers. **Human-amplified: yes** for the admitted discharge/confinement comparison, with both images witnessing the native operation rather than proving it. This whole **returns-to** [A17](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) with that bounded physical neighbour and **returns-to** [A18](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) with the reserve/extension relation intact. The [self-rolling wheel in the Neumann whole](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-self-rolling-wheel) **extends** this continuing formation from its exact p.18 authorial encounter. The wheel's winding composes the formed round about an opening it cannot turn into surface. Its movement and the paper's renewed inscription retain two different ways of making the next act possible. The source-specific En-Soph terminology remains there; this return keeps the wheel within the shared whole instead of treating its name as an interchangeable circular emblem.

whole_evidence.text: ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter.

whole_evidence.text: ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round.

whole_evidence.text: ## #2 Separation of the World Parents opens the interval in which a world can appear. Heaven is distinguishable from earth; light can enter the space between them. An undifferentiated enclosure becomes an articulated field with directions and contrasts. The ego emerges within this opening as a position able to discriminate. What appears outside it becomes nameable because the act of differentiation has also given the observer a place. The transmitted creation scene at the encounter's p.105 lead requires its own sequence. The primordial person recognises itself, then divides into the paired figure of man and woman previously held as if in an embrace. Self-recognition precedes sexual separation in this telling. The androgyne therefore performs a relational office: the two who become partners arise through differentiation of a prior togetherness. The image places sex and gender within a genesis of relation; its use here depends upon preserving the before, the embrace, the division and the changed relation afterward. The independent primary passage and its exact translation remain a source debt. Neumann's psychological reading stresses the achievement of ego identity and the discriminating consciousness that says I am I. Taylor's response separates that achievement from the more primordial self-recognition expressed in the native relation. Prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession of an identity; the finite experiencer and its inner instrument are determinations within the field of appearing. This authored distinction **returns-to** [the tattvic differential field](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), and **qualifies** [the bounded subject-position](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [the inner instrument](../../../episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation. It cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears. **Human-amplified: yes** for this explicit correction in Taylor's encounter; the psychological and Śaiva source offices retain their own evidence requirements. Light brings more than a collection of visible objects. In the leads at pp.106–109, an oriented world appears: above and below, before and behind, inside and outside, I and you, sacred and profane, good and evil. Boundaries make a precinct, a possession, a law and an order of action possible. Some of those institutional consequences are Taylor's authored extension of the encounter, not a verified universal history derived from Neumann. Their formal pressure is exact: a measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it. [Māyā as operative measure](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **qualifies** this refraction. Differentiation is productive; its danger begins when the selected measure conceals its dependence upon a wider field. The image cannot be held to a fixed light/good and dark/bad dictionary. Light names disclosure from one position; what that position leaves unlit belongs to the same field. Father and mother, active and receptive, inner and outer likewise change office with the direction of the relation. Taylor's local p.108 appointment of night at #0, day at #5 and four directions at #1–#4 gives this encounter a 4+2 articulation: the spatially specified field is held through implicate conditions of appearance and return. **Human-amplified: yes** for that local appointment. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable.

whole_evidence.text: ## #5→0 The separation returns as a question of love or war. Taylor's p.121 encounter makes knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim that its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of a shared genesis. Even denial takes place through the field it denies. This is a formal and mythemic assertion about relation. Separation made the world and the responsive centre possible. Its return has to preserve that achievement. The exact difference **returns-to** [the two logics of two](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). Polar distinction is necessary. Its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation: `(-1)+(+1)=0` cancels the signed terms, while `(-1)-(+1)=-2` and the inverse subtraction `(+1)-(-1)=+2` carry the two appropriative orientations. The native relation `(0/1)/(1/0)` retains the directions together without converting QL's slash into ordinary division by zero. Taylor's guilt reading locates the loss in a determination disowning its `/0`; the relation itself has not been annihilated. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cut/bond and love/war reading in the protected encounter. The claim survives with productive difference and the right of actual others to answer on their own terms. The differentiated world now sees its own means of seeing. This whole **returns-to** [contextual transparency](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **figures** [diaphaneity](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): light, boundary and orientation become available together with the source relations and exclusions that made them effective. [Gebser's source house](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **compares** a distinct account of consciousness structures and integral transparency. Its contextual return can illuminate this passage without equating its structures one for one with Neumann's stadial sequence. **Human-amplified: no** for such a blanket stage identity. The shared field retains both accounts in their distinct temporal and epistemic offices. The centre's power to discriminate **returns-to** [local arbitration](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), **qualifies** [the complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md), and **extends** the question into [image, valuation and possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). An image helps organise action; possession begins when that organisation claims the authority of its own source. The Great Mother as engulfing power, the father's arresting law and the victorious hero are different possible occupants of that office. None is condemned simply for giving a world its form. [Arbitration, hybris, regard and anamnesis](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the return of judgement: the determining centre must recognise the conditions of its measure and allow encounter to alter it. [The living symbol and idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) and [the archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **qualify** the source/image distinction. The image remains alive while the relation can change its meaning; its power of disclosure is lost when its present interpretation is made final. The liberated relation **returns-to** [trust, faith and the formal limit](../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [self and other without possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). Shared origin neither eliminates risk nor gives one participant ownership of another. Trust has force because the response cannot be manufactured in advance; recognition includes the possibility that an actual other changes the terms of the encounter. The captive and the heroic union carry this pressure as images. They do not prove the historical or ethical claims of every story to which those names have been applied. For [mind as worldhood](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), to which this whole **returns-to**, the developing centre and its world form together through discrimination, valuation, inherited relation and response. The shared archetypal field supplies more than a sequence of private mental contents. It is a condition of intelligible individuation. The technical extension asks how an agent's context, memory, tools and collective relations can make that formation inspectable; artificial phenomenality and the encounter's question of a reversed individual-to-collective developmental route remain **Open**. **Human-amplified: no** for an achieved technical mechanism or a phenomenality conclusion. The structural claim is retained at full strength without inventing its implementation. This same distinction **returns-to** [idealism and order of dependence](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The primordial relation is ontologically and epistemically consequential in the essay; it is not the chronological manufacture of the world by a private ego. The centre cannot make the conditions of appearing into its possession. Its return therefore **returns-to** [compassion as loving sensitivity to origins](../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): what has become this person or this act includes nourishment, deprivation, dependence, separation and labour. Knowing those origins becomes compassion through the orientation that refuses to consume the being it understands. Responsibility remains; a more adequate field becomes available in which to exercise it. [Taylor's Draft 3 source house](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **extends** that return through the offered work and the reader's office of remembrance. Finally, this whole **qualifies** [the first advent of zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) and **returns-to** [the advent of integral zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md). The round and the paper scene do not establish the history of mathematical zero. They let the exact sign re-enter a living symbolic relation after its mathematical office has been earned. The return preserves that office. As the transformed centre retains its differentiation, the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign. What comes back is the capacity to begin with the source relation visible in the determination: a mark made, a world opened, a separation borne, an image released to be answered. The source standing remains precise. Neumann is citation-ready, with selected external passages still unpromoted; the page leads belong to the consulted 2014 Princeton Classics encounter, whose pagination has not been collated against the 1954 English edition. No copied Neumann or transmitted Upaniṣadic sentence is presented here as quotation-ready. Jung's *Aion* has no selected excerpts ready in its current house; Gebser retains locator debts. Taylor's native material is internally sourced, and the protected encounter distinguishes authorial reading from its initial scaffold. **Human-amplified: no** for the scaffold's unratified one-to-one Taoist, gender or stadial equivalences. These provenance limits **qualify** historical attribution and quotation; they leave the declared **Argued** mythemic operations and native formal derivation in their proper force.

whole_evidence.text: ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round.

whole_evidence.text: ## #3 The hero is born within the world opened by the separation. Neumann's sequence then carries two emancipations: the slaying of the mother, followed by the slaying of the father. The maternal struggle addresses the engulfing origin from which the hero must become distinct. The paternal struggle addresses the authority that can arrest that emergence in an inherited order. If the telling stopped after escape from the mother, the father's law could simply inherit the power of enclosure. Keeping both struggles in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, rather than to the replacement of one captor by another. The violence belongs to the mythic and psychological telling. Its operation is differentiation from an overwhelming archetypal claim. Neumann's historically gendered morphology remains visible as his account. The page's relational reading follows the changing offices in the drama, including the earlier androgyne and the later possibility of partnership. Removing those changes would turn a developing relation into a static classification of persons. The next movement is the captive, the treasure and liberation. In the book's order this precedes the Osiris transformation. The achieved power to separate is now tested by what it releases and what becomes available through release. A captive liberated into another form of possession would leave the deeper problem intact. That last sentence states the essay's authored pressure upon the image: heroic efficacy has to be judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters. It does not invent a missing passage in Neumann's account. The Osiris division then carries the book's culminating transformation office. Death and transformation prevent the developmental movement from closing as the hero's permanent occupancy of a victorious identity. The canonical source navigation warrants this office and sequence; it does not yet warrant a detailed retelling of every Osiris episode. Detailed Osiris episodes require separately recovered primary tellings and comparative passages. Here the consequential change is that an ego strong enough to emerge must also become capable of transformation beyond its established form. Centroversion gathers the movement. The formation of a whole personality requires traffic between the centre and the powers from which it differentiated. Both engulfment and sovereign isolation obstruct that traffic. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. This source-specific psychological account **returns-to** [individuation and recognition](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). whole_evidence.text: ## #0 The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them can stand apart and call them parents. In Neumann's creation sequence, heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together. Its apparently enclosed outline carries the life that will differentiate it: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The first pressure in the image is therefore genesis: how a world and a centre within that world become distinct through a relation neither creates alone. This whole carries **shared archetypal structuration**: genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. It is the archetypal ground through which geographically situated tellings and temporal developments become comparable. Geography gives each telling its people, language and historical home; temporality gives its transformations their order and duration. Those registers remain distinct from the common structure disclosed here. The universal field belongs to the essay's native QL account; Neumann supplies a developed psychological morphology through which that field receives an imaginal and bodily refraction. His sequence is neither the derivation of QL nor a geographical address for the universal. [Neumann's source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the telling: the uroboros, Great Mother, separation of the World Parents, birth of the hero, slaying of mother and father, liberation of the captive and treasure, then the Osiris transformation. His book presents these as stages in the development of consciousness. The source's stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return.
